ns2:course.label: Disruption and Emerging Technologies
ns2:course.description: In today's rapidly evolving technological landscape, it is crucial for individuals to develop a comprehensive understanding of emerging technologies and their potential impact on various sectors. This course aims to equip students with the knowledge and skills necessary to critically analyze emerging technologies, assess their development, explore current applications, and identify challenges that may hinder their future impact. Credit is not given toward graduation for both BDI 477 and BDI 577. Prerequisite: Restricted to students in the online Master of Business Administration (iMBA) program or the online Master of Science in Accountancy (iMSA) program.
